messages.subject: Garrety - draft settlement agreement (SUBJECT TO CONTRACT)
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

Without prejudice and subject to contract. I attach our first draft of the settlement agreement reflecting our offer. The ex-gratia is in at £85k and the covenants at 12 months for now; we can discuss your client's asks but I'm not yet instructed to move. Please send any mark-up as a redline.

Kind regards,
Tom Gallagher
Associate | Employment & Disputes
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0834
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
